refusal.layout: one int32 failure flag per distinct source/field cause plus a separate zeroed uint64 index workspace
refusal.source_id: pinned source line number; nonzero only on refusal
refusal.record_conversion: After synchronization, for each nonzero int32 flag, combine the mapped source_id and field_id with failure_detail[slot]-1 to form the host AdFailureRecord.
refusal.ordering: integer atomicOr for flags and integer atomicMax for element details; deterministic under concurrent refusals

reduction.order: Repeated fixed 256-thread binary trees; grid=ceil(n/512); use disjoint input/output buffers, then add the sole result to each parameter cotangent in one thread.
reduction.required_integration: Load the two auxiliary symbols from the adjoint cubin and schedule all passes after __ad on the same stream.

alias_contract: Exact repeated targets within rates share one derivative allocation; the reverse gathers them in source order. Other fields are disjoint under the default ABI; incoming output seeds are separate from input bars.
bounds_contract: Host validates nlev, ncells, nspecies, 0 <= nsolve <= ncells, signed-index products, table lengths and target capacities. pbl_indices[0] is in [0,nspecies), and every other nonnegative pbl_indices or cu_indices entry is less than nspecies.
floating_policy: Tested strict route: compile derivative with --fmad=false --ftz=false --prec-div=true; the recorded strict forward uses --ftz=false. Arithmetic is differentiated mathematically and nonfinite values and zero denominators refuse the gradient. At integration the derivative denormal mode must match the forward image; fast mode uses --ftz=true. Fast-route derivative and compiled-out helper branch recording have not been verified by this task.
verification_status: Corrected int32 refusal ABI; two convection_permitting captured-step v5 dot tests and bitwise reverse checks passed. Taylor and proof-of-record status are recorded in the task receipt.

conformance_notes: Branch census code is present but must be verified at base and perturbed captured states before accepting a Taylor proof.
Dynamic helper repetition, workspace routing and expression evaluation require binder integration; interim harness schedules them explicitly.

Workspace init zero applies once to each allocation before its first use. A workspace alias binds existing storage without clearing it. The reduction input and output of each pass are disjoint; skip every reduction and accumulation for an initial count of zero. These routing and repeat annotations require an implementing backend; a backend that cannot honor them must refuse the derivative launch.

affine_reason: The active rates, mass, moisture and thermodynamic factors are multiplied and divided (source lines 1767-1792).

numerics_mode.fast_route: not verified; binder must match forward image and reconcile helper branch instrumentation

seed_lifetime.contract: Incoming output adjoints are separate from accumulating input adjoints; consumed overwritten slots are exact +0.0, untouched slots remain bitwise unchanged (COMMON-AD section 74).
seed_lifetime.overwrite_mask: out_theta and out_rho: cells i % ncells < nsolve; out_q: those cells and species selected by an enabled pbl/cu map. All other seed slots retain their incoming bits.
seed_lifetime.refusal: No gradient is published after a failure; partially updated scratch and seeds must be discarded.

ledger_resolution.scope: Owned judgement identities listed in branches[].ledger_sites; fixed integer lookups retain active selected floating values.
ledger_resolution.additional_inactive_index_slots: No active mask is required for fixed integer selection or literal loop bounds.
ledger_resolution.numerical_evidence: Existing GPU runs used the original recorded prefix; added lookup and literal-loop entries have no active branch mask.
